articles.title: Anmol Ekka Double Fires India Into Fourth Straight Junior Asia Cup Final
articles.excerpt: India beat Malaysia 3-1 in Moqi, China, with captain Ekka scoring twice and goalkeeper Vivek Lakra saving a penalty stroke; South Korea await in Sunday's final.
articles.image_caption: India's junior men's hockey team in action. Anmol Ekka's double fired the defending champions into a fourth straight Junior Asia Cup final.
articles.nri_angle: Anmol Ekka's 16-goal breakout gives diaspora hockey fans a new star to follow as India's junior pipeline builds toward the Junior World Cup.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's New Zealand Tour Sells 50,000 Tickets in Two Weeks
articles.excerpt: NZ Cricket sold more than 50,000 tickets in just over two weeks for India's first tour in six years, reopening Eden Park's sixth tier for the first time since 2019.
articles.image_caption: A packed cricket stadium under lights during a night match. Tickets for India's tour of New Zealand sold 50,000 seats within two weeks.
articles.nri_angle: India fixtures draw the largest and loudest diaspora crowds of any touring side in New Zealand, home to one of the world's fastest-growing Indian communities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Kuldeep Yadav's Career-Best Ten-For Powers Yorkshire to Innings Win Over Essex
articles.excerpt: The India wrist-spinner's 10 for 120 — his first ten-wicket haul in first-class cricket — sank Essex twice at Headingley and all but sealed Yorkshire's Division One survival.
articles.image_caption: Kuldeep Yadav during a visit to the Prime Minister's Office in New Delhi. Yadav took a career-best ten-wicket haul for Yorkshire in their innings win over Essex.
articles.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans in England watched a home hero dominate at Headingley, and Kuldeep's county form is being closely tracked in India ahead of future tours.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Shami Breaks Silence on India Absence, Sets Sights on Comeback
articles.excerpt: Marking his 100th first-class match with a Duleep Trophy title, the 36-year-old pacer says his eyes are on the "next level" — as selectors insist they stayed in touch through his England-tour absence.
articles.image_caption: Mohammed Shami after receiving the Arjuna Award. Shami has broken his silence on his absence from the India squad and says he is targeting a comeback.
articles.nri_angle: Indian diaspora cricket fans and US club/community players follow Shami's comeback push as the national team's most decorated active quick.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: New Zealand Captain Santner Turns Down Big BBL Deal to Lead Against India
articles.excerpt: The 34-year-old rejected a two-year Adelaide Strikers offer to keep his New Zealand central contract and white-ball captaincy ahead of the India home series.
articles.nri_angle: The India vs New Zealand home series is the marquee event Santner prioritised — directly relevant to the Indian cricket diaspora, which follows the fixture intensely.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Women's Spinners Bundle Pakistan Out for 55 in Asia Cup Rout
articles.excerpt: Left-arm spinner Shree Charani's 3 for 7 led a spin masterclass in Dubai, and Harmanpreet Kaur sealed a seven-wicket win in 8.4 overs in her 150th T20I as captain.
articles.nri_angle: India-Pakistan cricket is appointment viewing for the South Asian diaspora, and this rout gave fans across the US, Canada, UK and the Gulf a night to savour.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tanya Chaudhary Smashes National Hammer Throw Record Days Before Asian Games
articles.excerpt: The Uttar Pradesh athlete sent the hammer to 68.35m at the Indian Athletics Series Final on Thursday, breaking 18-year-old Anushka Yadav's record with the Aichi-Nagoya Games beginning September 19.
articles.nri_angle: India's rising women's hammer throw, led by Chaudhary and Yadav, gives diaspora track fans a genuine medal hope at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Georgia Teen Anannya Aneesh Earns Spot at 2027 U19 Women's World Cup
articles.excerpt: The Mountain View High School senior helped the USA Women's U19 team sweep the Americas Qualifier to reach the 2027 ICC U19 Women's T20 World Cup.
articles.nri_angle: Aneesh's arc — falling in love with cricket through the IPL with her father in Georgia, representing the USA, and planning to play in India — runs the full arc of the diaspora cricket dream.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Rout Pakistan 19-0 to Storm Into Junior Women's Hockey Asia Cup Semis
articles.excerpt: India's junior women thrashed Pakistan 19-0 in their Women's Junior Asia Cup quarterfinal in Moqi, China — Pooja Malik hit a hat-trick and the defending champions, now two wins from a third straight continental title, face the South Korea-Malaysia winner in the semifinals.
articles.image_caption: Action from the India-Pakistan match at the Women's Junior Asia Cup in Moqi, China. India won the quarterfinal 19-0 to storm into the semifinals.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora families whose kids play field hockey in US and Canadian leagues, this junior side — defending champions now two wins from a three-peat — is the next generation to watch, with several of these names likely to step into the senior India squad within a year or two.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bumrah Included, Yash Thakur Replaces Harshit Rana in India T20I Squads
articles.excerpt: The BCCI on Thursday named Vidarbha pacer Yash Thakur as Harshit Rana's replacement for the Afghanistan T20Is and the 2026 Asian Games after Rana suffered a rectus femoris strain during a match simulation, while Jasprit Bumrah, Nitish Kumar Reddy and Washington Sundar all made the cut.
articles.image_caption: India fast bowler Yash Thakur trains with the national squad. The 27-year-old Vidarbha pacer was named as Harshit Rana's replacement for the Afghanistan T20Is and the 2026 Asian Games.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian fans in the US, UK and Canada who follow the team through late-night streams and diaspora watch parties, a settled pace attack — Bumrah back, Thakur blooded — sets the tone for the home season and the Asian Games campaign in Nagoya.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Antim Panghal Confident as India Targets Wrestling Gold at Asian Games
articles.excerpt: The women's 53kg wrestler says a senior-junior mix, three months of joint training and a Japanese coach have the squad ready for Aichi-Nagoya.
articles.image_caption: Two wrestlers grapple on the mat during a bout. Antim Panghal heads into the Asian Games as one of India’s leading medal hopes in wrestling.
articles.nri_angle: The Asian Games are a marquee quadrennial event for the diaspora's sporting calendar, and wrestling remains one of the disciplines where Indian fans abroad expect podium finishes.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Firm Favourites as Bangladesh Eye Upset in Women's Asia Cup Semi-Final
articles.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur's unbeaten side meet Bangladesh in Dubai on Thursday, chasing a record-extending eighth Asia Cup title.
articles.image_caption: Players from India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Pakistan in a Women’s Asia Cup 2026 semi-final graphic. India face Bangladesh in the last-four clash.
articles.nri_angle: The 8 PM IST start (7:30 AM Pacific) makes this a morning watch for the US diaspora, with SonyLIV and Sony Max carrying the game for Indian fans abroad.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Vinicius Jr and Raphinha Headline Brazil Squad for Historic First Friendly in India
articles.excerpt: Carlo Ancelotti named a 26-man squad for the October 3 fixture at Salt Lake Stadium — his first since Brazil's World Cup exit, and a clear changing of the guard.
articles.image_caption: Brazil forward Vinicius Jr celebrates in the national team colours. Vinicius and Raphinha headline Brazil’s squad for their historic first friendly on Indian soil.
articles.nri_angle: The first-ever Brazil-India fixture gives football-mad Kolkata a landmark night and draws the Indian diaspora's large global football audience toward the Indian game.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: East Zone One Day From Duleep Trophy Glory as Kishan Shines Again
articles.excerpt: East Zone closed day four of the Duleep Trophy final at 212 for 5, a 584-run lead over South Zone, with Ishan Kishan's second-innings 80 following his 270 and leaving a first title in 14 years within reach.
articles.image_caption: Ishan Kishan. The wicketkeeper-batter starred for East Zone as they closed in on Duleep Trophy glory.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora cricket fans following Ishan Kishan's comeback get another signal that his India recall case is building at Chepauk.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Hardik Pandya Named in India A Squad for Australia A Home Series in Puducherry
articles.excerpt: The all-rounder, who has not played competitive cricket since IPL 2026, has been included in the one-day squad subject to fitness clearance as India plan his return ahead of the ODI World Cup.
articles.image_caption: Indian cricketer Hardik Pandya. The all-rounder has been named in the India A squad for the home series against Australia A in Puducherry.
articles.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans across the diaspora are closely tracking Pandya's fitness comeback, with the all-rounder seen as pivotal to India's ODI World Cup campaign in 2027.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ishan Kishan's 270 in Duleep Trophy Final Caps Remarkable Comeback From BCCI Exile
articles.excerpt: The East Zone captain scored a monumental 270 against South Zone after spending two years outside India's squad, saying he freed his mind from overthinking to focus solely on scoring runs.
articles.image_caption: YouTube / CricRajnish
articles.nri_angle: Kishan's comeback resonates with the Indian cricket community worldwide as a story of perseverance through the BCCI system.

articles.title: Asian Games 2026 in Japan: India's Complete Multi-Sport Schedule From Cricket to Athletics
articles.excerpt: India will field athletes across more than 20 sporting disciplines at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games from September 19 to October 4, defending titles in cricket, kabaddi, and men's hockey.
articles.image_caption: The 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. India is sending its largest-ever multi-sport contingent to compete across cricket, athletics, and more.
articles.nri_angle: Comprehensive guide for Indian diaspora fans tracking India's medal hopes across multiple sports at the Asian Games in Japan.

articles.title: From Post-Pregnancy Arthritis to CWG Bronze: Seema Kaliramna Eyes Asian Games Medal
articles.excerpt: The 27-year-old discus thrower from Haryana returned from severe arthritis after childbirth to win Commonwealth Games bronze, and now targets the Asian Games in Japan as a step toward the Olympics.
articles.image_caption: Discus thrower Seema Kaliramna won a bronze medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. She is now targeting a medal at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya.
articles.nri_angle: Kaliramna's story of comeback through motherhood and arthritis resonates with diaspora audiences following Indian athletics ahead of the Asian Games.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Delhi Capitals Owner Ends KL Rahul Trade Speculation Ahead of IPL 2027
articles.excerpt: Co-owner Parth Jindal declared 'we have unfinished business' after weeks of rumours linking the 34-year-old batter with Kolkata Knight Riders.
articles.image_caption: Indian cricketer KL Rahul. Delhi Capitals owner Parth Jindal has moved to end speculation about Rahul's trade ahead of IPL 2027.
articles.nri_angle: KL Rahul's IPL future is a major talking point for cricket fans across the diaspora, with the Delhi Capitals aiming to build a championship squad ahead of IPL 2027.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Cricket Australia Opens Big Bash League to Private Investment Starting With Melbourne Renegades
articles.excerpt: The governing body will invite bids for the Renegades franchise from the 2027-28 season, opening the door for IPL owners and other investors despite opposition from New South Wales and Queensland.
articles.image_caption: A Big Bash League match. Cricket Australia has opened the league to private investment, starting with the Melbourne Renegades.
articles.nri_angle: IPL franchise groups could soon own stakes in BBL clubs, extending the Indian cricket economy's reach into Australia and connecting the two biggest cricket markets for diaspora fans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mark Chapman Drops NZ Central Contract to Chase Big Bash League Opportunity
articles.excerpt: The New Zealand batter will play the white-ball series against India in November before heading to Australia for the BBL, while fast bowler Matt Fisher takes his spot on the full-time contract list.
articles.image_caption: New Zealand batter Mark Chapman examines a ball during a match. Chapman has shifted from a full New Zealand Cricket contract to a casual deal for the 2026-27 season to pursue an opportunity in Australia's Big Bash League.
articles.nri_angle: Chapman remains committed to the India series in November, a marquee fixture for cricket fans in the diaspora.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Ashish Nehra Calls Gill and Pandya "North Pole and South Pole" as Captains
articles.excerpt: The Gujarat Titans head coach compared his two skippers' contrasting leadership styles, backing the reserved Shubman Gill to grow into India's captaincy while praising Hardik Pandya's openness and trust.
articles.image_caption: Indian cricketer Shubman Gill. Gujarat Titans head coach Ashish Nehra described Gill and Hardik Pandya as contrasting captaincy styles during a Cricket Association of Bengal awards ceremony.
articles.nri_angle: Gill's captaincy trajectory across formats is central to the next era of Indian cricket, closely watched by fans worldwide.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Karun Nair Walks Out of South Zone Duleep Trophy Camp, Scores Defiant Century
articles.excerpt: After being overlooked for both the semi-final and final, the veteran Karnataka batter left the squad and smashed 104 for KSCA Secretary XI, calling his exclusion "inexplicable."
articles.image_caption: Indian cricketer Karun Nair, who left the South Zone squad during the Duleep Trophy final and scored a defiant century in a KSCA tournament in Bengaluru.
articles.nri_angle: The selection controversy touches on merit-based picking in Indian cricket, a perennial debate among diaspora fans invested in the national team.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Salil Ankola's Journey: From Debuting With Tendulkar to Fighting a Bone Tumour and Severe Depression
articles.excerpt: The former Indian fast bowler, who played his only Test alongside a teenage Sachin Tendulkar, saw his career cut short by a shin tumour at 28 and has recently spoken about his battle with mental health.
articles.image_caption: Former India cricketer Salil Ankola, who made his Test debut alongside Sachin Tendulkar in 1989. He has spoken publicly about his battles with a bone tumour and severe depression.
articles.nri_angle: Ankola's openness about depression resonates with a broader conversation about mental health in the Indian diaspora and challenges the stigma that persists in cricket culture.

articles.title: Shafali Verma Rewrites Record Books as India Crush Pakistan in Women's Asia Cup
articles.excerpt: The 22-year-old opener becomes the youngest and fastest player to reach 3,000 Women's T20I runs during India's seven-wicket demolition of Pakistan in Dubai.
articles.nri_angle: Shafali Verma's record-breaking form ahead of the Asian Games strengthens India's title defence, with diaspora fans tracking the squad's progress toward Aichi-Nagoya.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Cricket Schedule, Squads and Draw for Asian Games 2026 in Japan
articles.excerpt: Shreyas Iyer and Harmanpreet Kaur lead India's men's and women's teams at the Korogi Athletic Park in Aichi-Nagoya, with the women's tournament starting September 17 and men's on September 24.
articles.nri_angle: Indian cricket fans abroad can watch both Asian Games tournaments on Sony Sports Network and Sony LIV as India defends its double gold.

articles.title: Yuki Bhambri Eyes Deeper US Open Run After Last Year's Breakthrough Doubles Semifinal
articles.excerpt: The Indian tennis star reunites with New Zealand's Michael Venus at Flushing Meadows, calling it a 'mental switch' after reaching the 2025 semifinals.
articles.image_caption: Indian tennis player Yuki Bhambri at the 2022 Roland Garros qualifiers. Bhambri and doubles partner Michael Venus open their 2026 US Open campaign after reaching last year's semifinals.
articles.nri_angle: Indian tennis representation at Grand Slams resonates with the diaspora, and Bhambri specifically mentions the electric support from Indian fans at Flushing Meadows.

articles.title: Harmanpreet Kaur Becomes First Cricketer to Captain 150 T20 Internationals
articles.excerpt: The India captain reached the landmark during the Women's Asia Cup match against Pakistan in Dubai, extending her lead over every male and female captain in history.
articles.image_caption: India captain Harmanpreet Kaur with the 2025 Women's Cricket World Cup trophy. Kaur has become the first cricketer to captain 150 T20 Internationals.
articles.nri_angle: Harmanpreet Kaur's record captaincy milestone showcases the growing global stature of Indian women's cricket, a source of pride for the diaspora.

articles.title: India's Blue Colts Blank Bangladesh 3-0 to Keep AFC U-20 Asian Cup Dream Alive
articles.excerpt: Goals from Danny Meitei Laishram, Vishal Yadav, and Md Arbash sealed a convincing win in Tashkent, leaving India's first U-20 Asian Cup qualification in 20 years dependent on other results.
articles.image_caption: India's under-20 football team, the Blue Colts, in action. India beat Bangladesh 3-0 to keep their AFC U-20 Asian Cup qualification hopes alive.
articles.nri_angle: Indian football's grassroots development and the U-20 team's bid to end a 20-year absence from a major continental tournament matters to diaspora fans tracking the sport's growth back home.

articles.title: Mohammad Yousuf Says Pakistan Cricket's Decline Began After 2021 Win Over India
articles.excerpt: The former batting great traced the national team's current crisis to the overconfidence that followed their famous T20 World Cup victory, while separately criticizing the PCB's mid-tour mass sacking during the England series.

articles.nri_angle: Pakistan cricket's ongoing crisis and India-Pakistan rivalry are followed passionately by the large South Asian diaspora in the US.
